Traveling, your dream for Apple accessories is just one item, not a pile of cables and plug adapters. There are many choices on the market, but most are bulky. The Anker Prime Qi2 25W foldable 3-in-1 wireless charger is designed to solve this problem. It folds flat, weighs about the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max, and can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods.

MagSafe Monday column: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest products and technology in the MagSafe and wireless charging space, helping you get the most out of your wireless charging-supported Apple devices.

A foldable 3-in-1 charger

The selling point of this product is right in its name: it's palm-sized, and when folded flat it can fit into a pocket, handbag, or travel sling bag without taking up any space at all. I've carried many MagSafe stands when traveling, and almost every time they've been the bulkiest item in my laptop bag.

Qi2 25-watt charging speed

This charger is Qi2.2 certified and can deliver up to 25 watts of MagSafe charging, a significant boost over the 7.5-watt ceiling that most MagSafe accessories have long been limited to. Anker says it can charge an iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in 26 minutes, up to 5 times faster than a standard 5-watt wireless charger. Actual performance will vary depending on the iPhone model and device temperature, but even coming close to that level is already more than adequate.

Faster MagSafe charging usually means more heat, so Anker added a temperature control feature called AirCool. The fan operates at only 19 decibels, quiet enough to be barely audible, and is designed to keep the phone temperature below 98.6°F (about 37°C) while charging at full 25 watts. Heat is the enemy of battery longevity and charging speed; if this promise truly holds up in daily use, it's not just marketing talk but a genuinely useful feature.

The 3-in-1 layout includes a main MagSafe puck for charging the iPhone, an MFi-certified Apple Watch charger on the side, and a charging pad on the bottom for AirPods. This is the core selling point of this type of charging stand: one cable to the wall replaces three separate chargers plus three separate cables filling up your bag. Here's what's included in the Anker box:

  • Anker Prime wireless charging stand
  • 45-watt USB-C wall adapter
  • 5-foot USB-C to USB-C cable

I really appreciate that Anker includes a wall adapter in the box, because many similar chargers assume you already have a suitable fast-charging power brick. It also supports 110V to 220V input, so no matter where you travel, you won't need to bring an extra adapter.

Summary

Over the years Anker has released many 3-in-1 chargers, but the foldable design sets this product apart in a crowded market. It addresses the reason most people would rather leave a charging stand behind when traveling: it's too hard to pack away. This one doesn't have that problem.

You can purchase the Anker Prime Qi2 25W foldable 3-in-1 wireless charger through Amazon or the Anker official website.
